Populate the local andara.core cache with a core this andara-cli does not embed.

andara-cli embeds one andara.core (`andara-cli version` names it), and a pack
requiring it compiles offline with no cache at all. --from reads another core's
pack directory from disk into the cache. It never fetches over Admin: a core this
binary doesn't embed comes with the andara-cli release that embeds it.

Usage:
  andara-cli content fetch-core [flags]

Flags:
      --cache string     core pack cache (default $ANDARA_CONTENT_CACHE, then ~/.cache/andara/packs)
      --from string      populate the cache from a pack directory on disk
  -h, --help             help for fetch-core
      --version uint32   the andara.core version to cache (default 1)

Global Flags:
      --config string            config file path (default $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/andara/cli.yaml)
      --credentials string       credential file path (default $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/andara/credentials.yaml)
      --log-level string         CLI diagnostic level (default "warn")
      --no-color                 disable ANSI output
  -o, --output string            output format: human or json (default "human")
      --server-address string    server endpoint (gRPC/Connect over TLS) (default "localhost:8443")
      --timeout duration         per-command deadline (default 30s)
      --tls-ca string            CA bundle to trust (empty uses the system trust store)
      --tls-server-name string   verify the server's certificate against this name, not the dialed host (a port-forward)
